## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fó wèi niánshào bǐqiū shuō zhèngshì jīng* (T502) is a one-fascicle short sūtra translated by [法炬](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%82%AC) Fǎjù. It contains the Buddha's pedagogical instruction to young monks (*nián-shào bǐqiū* 年少比丘) on the proper conduct of a *bhikṣu*.

**Abstract**

A short Hīnayāna sūtra on monastic conduct, addressed to novice monks. Translation falls within Fǎjù's productive period (290–306 CE).
